title: No-Bake Blueberry Lemon Chia Yogurt Cups
hookLine: 5-minute sugar-free blueberry chia jam layered over bright lemon Greek yogurt.

items.name: Wild blueberries + 2 tbsp chia seeds + lemon juice
Vanilla Greek yogurt or coconut yogurt

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {bj_blu} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Mash Warm Blueberries with Chia Seeds
steps.instructionTemplate: Warm {bj_blu} 3 mins until berries burst, let chia thicken into glossy jam 5 mins, then swirl over {bj_yog}. Let No-Bake Blueberry Lemon Chia Yogurt Cups cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Use room-temperature dairy and eggs for No-Bake Blueberry Lemon Chia Yogurt Cups, and pull it from the oven when the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs—overbaking dries it out.

steps.title: Bake No-Bake Blueberry Lemon Chia Yogurt Cups & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 3 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer No-Bake Blueberry Lemon Chia Yogurt Cups to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 160 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
